description: This Dart source file defines the ReportRepository class, a data access layer responsible for executing SQL queries related to financial reports such as totals, category breakdowns, weekly trends, and monthly summaries within a Flutter application. It interacts with a SQLite database and provides high-level methods for fetching report data based on date ranges, utilizing SQL aggregations and date functions.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods to generate various financial reports such as totals, category breakdowns, weekly trends, and monthly summaries by executing raw SQL queries on the application's SQLite database.

methods.name: totalsInRange
methods.description: Calculates total income and expenses within a specified date range by joining transactions and categories, returning a PeriodTotals object.

methods.name: categoryBreakdown
methods.description: Provides a list of category-wise spending breakdown within a date range, including category details and total amounts.

methods.name: weeklyTrend
methods.description: Generates a weekly trend with income and expense sums for each week in the given date range, approximating weeks by using SQLite's strftime function.

methods.name: monthlySummary
methods.description: Returns a list of monthly income and expense totals within the specified date range, grouped by month.

methods.name: quickTotals
methods.description: Provides a quick summary of total income, expenses, and net amount within a date range as a simple map.
